t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The red purple and pink gnomes correspond with the red basket while the other gnomes correspond with the yellow basket. Select the gnomes that correspond with one basket first and once you notice a decrease in mushrooms switch to picking the other basket and the gnomes that correspond with it.

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 different coloured gnomes and 2 different coloured baskets. The Red, Pink, Purple and Brown gnomes use the red basket.The Blue, Green, Yellow and Orange gnomes use the yellow basket.Pick either set of gnomes to start with and stick with them until the number of mushrooms you're picking gets too low, in which case switch to using the other basket.
